content: Peteroꞌa Odaḡa Sauꞌa Vazeḡa Fainiro
Mada ꞌahogano ḡorava mone mada uḡidu zamaḡano, Petero zu Ioaneꞌa kuru madaḡano kuru neḡa itiro.

Ebu Iraḡa Manoḡa rae huneꞌeteꞌe ibihetaḡa ꞌahoga genaḡano odaḡa sauꞌa vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa ehore radiro. Aniꞌe ꞌouge fureraro ebu vazeꞌa ani mada niduꞌa herate onamadu eꞌe ibihetaḡa genaḡano ohoninu, ebu ani kuru neḡa diuḡeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazao hadi umidinu.
Ani Petero zu Ioaneꞌa kuru neḡa diuḡihi raꞌenogano horozadu hadi umiziro.
Rehano Petero zu Ioaneꞌa ḡiane runadu Peteroꞌa niro, “Eme ḡiafoꞌi.”
Odaḡa sauꞌa vazeḡaꞌe ḡau ꞌahoga hidiꞌuma rae zamareꞌenaꞌa, ḡiaziro.
Rehano Peteroꞌa niro, “E hadihe
oꞌoꞌa rehano, eḡe mazao radiuꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa ḡaniꞌuma. Eḡeꞌa ḡaꞌohe, Nazareta vazeḡa Iesu Keriso niḡano iḡunadu onamoꞌi!”
Ebu Peteroꞌa ane edaꞌe ꞌevoꞌa mae ḡihinirotene, odaḡa zu kekeḡaniꞌa tabara inariro.
Ebu ani rafate iḡune edaro zu oname onairo. Ebu ani rafate onameꞌenaꞌa zu Badiꞌa niguneꞌenaꞌa, zeḡe teite kuru neḡa diuḡiro.
Vaze niduꞌa aniꞌa Badiꞌa niguneꞌenaꞌa, oname onaeꞌeteꞌe horoniro.
Ebu ze aniꞌe kuru neḡa ibihetaḡa, Iraḡa Manoḡa genaḡano iḡaiḡa ehoradu vaze mazao hadi umidinuteꞌe vazeḡa rae ederiro. Ebu ane mazao naginiꞌa fureraroteꞌe uꞌano, ze zaguzagau rudaro.
Peteroꞌa Kuru Neḡa Habaꞌano Haramiro
Odaḡa manoriroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa Petero zu Ioane hegote ragaveꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, vaze niduꞌa zaguzaganadu kuru neḡa habaꞌano Solomona Ibi Zauhaḡano zeḡe vaḡe isau dure ariro.

Peteroꞌa vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa aroga horozadu ziro, “Isaraela azaḡa, za nougaꞌahi zaguzagauꞌohe? Ebu nougaꞌahi ḡiaḡiafeꞌohe? Za emeꞌa gigiꞌafe hina vaze ꞌahi faineha ga eme hube hune Badiꞌa gubaneꞌeteꞌe uꞌano ani faineha rae zamareꞌehe?

Aberahamo, Isako, Iakobo zu vouḡafeꞌa kuranohaunuteꞌe Badiꞌaḡaniꞌa ane tuḡure vazeḡa Iesu mae ḡihiniro. Rehano zaꞌe ani Pilato ꞌevoreo riꞌiniro. Ebu Pilatoꞌa ani tuḡune bunihi rae reirotene, zaeꞌa Pilato zamao ani hezahoharo.
Zaꞌe Vaze Zaḡoḡa zu Duduḡa hezahoharo, u vaze runediroteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoga mae bunoga umidiro.
ꞌOugadu zaꞌe ḡaboneziniꞌeteꞌe Zuhiꞌaḡa Boro maro. Rehano aniꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡaboniro. Eme eꞌe horonadu ꞌahi rae fureneꞌohe.
Iesu mazao fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, zaꞌa horoneꞌeteꞌe zu edereꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahi faineha. Iesu ni gigiꞌaḡa zu ane mazao fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, vaze ꞌahaꞌa manore huneha. Zae niduꞌa ꞌahi horoneꞌohe.
Nego nabudi, e edeḡa, zae ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa teige zae zuni aḡuꞌa radu Iesu maro.
Rehano Kerisoꞌa aduga hiditeꞌe moneo Badiꞌaꞌa peroveta azaḡa niduꞌaonoꞌo amahi rae fureniroteꞌeꞌa ꞌahige hudaro.
Eꞌanoꞌo zaꞌe ḡihuradu Badiꞌa vaḡe bare aroꞌi. ꞌOugine aneꞌa haḡaize sauꞌa vuzuꞌe modiꞌuma,
ebu Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa vineze izifiteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ariꞌuma, ebu zae veize Badiꞌaꞌa amahi ohoniroteꞌe vazeḡa, Keriso tuḡuniꞌuma. Aniꞌe Iesu.
Rehano ibite madaḡano Badiꞌaꞌa peroveta zaḡoḡa azaḡaonoꞌo rae fureniroteꞌe teige, Iesuꞌe adureo ꞌize radiꞌuma, onamo ḡau niduꞌa izifiteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ariꞌuma.
Moseꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, 'Zuhiꞌa Boro zae Badiꞌaꞌa zae ḡoere ḡumu azaḡa boꞌaḡano peroveta vazeḡa ꞌahoga eḡe heuḡa zae veize ohoniꞌuma. Aniꞌa nagini ziteꞌe ḡoeꞌa niduꞌa egohanoꞌi.
Iniu ani ḡoere mene egohauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Badiꞌa mone azaḡa mazaonoꞌo mae vaḡizadu ruiziꞌuma.'
Ebu Samuela zu ane ḡaruna ariroteꞌe peroveta azaḡa niduꞌa zuni izidi fureruꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa moneo irina rae fureniro.
Zaꞌe peroveta azaḡa mariga, zu Badiꞌaꞌa zae vouḡa teite tiroteꞌe ḡoitoreḡa ḡoeꞌa meiroteꞌe azaḡa. Mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa Aberahamo niro, 'Marigo mazaonoꞌo habaꞌahabaꞌa azaḡa niduꞌa manohuga hidiꞌuma.'
Badiꞌaꞌa ane tuḡure vazeḡa ohonadu zae mazao ibite tuḡuniro. Aꞌe, aniꞌa zae tibatiba sauꞌa ibiḡanonoꞌo mae vaḡizadu manohuga zinifine raꞌohe.”
